mapper.sql: COALESCE(factory_code, '') org_key, MAX(factory_code) factory_code, COUNT(*) qty, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING_ALLOC'), 0) pending, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'TO_PUSH'), 0) to_push, COALESCE(SUM(suspend IS NOT NULL), 0) suspended, MAX(updated_at) handled_at, COALESCE(SUM(status <> 'PENDING_ALLOC'), 0) alloc_qty, COALESCE(SUM(status <> 'PENDING_ALLOC' AND suspend IS NOT NULL), 0) alloc_suspended, MAX(CASE WHEN status <> 'PENDING_ALLOC' THEN customer_code END) alloc_customer
